top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks unite a clean quantum-mechanical mechanism—magic-wavelength confinement suppressing motional shifts—with decisive, independently realized experimental capability and mature fundamental-physics uses. A narrowly bounded award to Katori and Ye best preserves the link between the foundational concept, decisive development, and attributable achievement.
recusal_note: No direct conflict is apparent from the supplied profile. I share the Gothenburg physics environment with Göran Johansson and Eva Olsson, but no specific collaboration or interest concerning B013 has been identified.
